isRecentDuplicate: function isRecentDuplicate(toolName, callerKey, args, windowMs = 10000) { const now = Date.now(); const key = recentDuplicateKey(toolName, callerKey, args); const prev = recentRequests.get(key); if (prev && now - prev < windowMs) return true; rememberMutationRecentRequestPreviousValue(key); recentRequests.set(key, now); for (const [k,t] of recentRequests) if(now-t > 60000) recentRequests.delete(k); return false; }
forgetRecentDuplicate: function forgetRecentDuplicate(toolName, callerKey, args) { const key = recentDuplicateKey(toolName, callerKey, args); rememberMutationRecentRequestPreviousValue(key); recentRequests.delete(key); }
recentDuplicateKey: function recentDuplicateKey(toolName, callerKey, args) { return toolName + ':' + callerKey + ':digest-v1:' + createHmac('sha256', runtime.secret).update(stableStringify(args ?? {})).digest('hex'); }
